title: The $47K Tax Trick Hiding in Your Losing Stocks
hook: Every investor has red positions right now — and the IRS built a legal shortcut that turns those losses into real tax savings most people never claim.
angle: Tax-loss harvesting is one of the most powerful yet underused personal finance strategies — it's free, legal, and most brokers never explain it to you
audience: Working adults ages 25-50 who have a brokerage account or IRA with individual stocks
key_numbers: $3,000 deductible from ordinary income each year
65% of investors never use tax-loss harvesting
$47,000 saved over 30 years of consistent use
Losses carry forward indefinitely — they never expire
